description: L2-regularized linear regression. Predicts all 3 velocity-discrepancy targets simultaneously.

math.solution: w = (X^T X + alpha*I)^{-1} X^T y  [closed-form, no gradient descent]
math.intuition: L2 penalty shrinks coefficients toward zero, reducing variance from correlated features (e.g. rolling-mean pairs). Optimal alpha balances bias-variance trade-off.

assumptions: Linear relationship between features and targets
Gaussian i.i.d. residuals (violated by zero-order-hold targets — acknowledged)
No multi-collinearity severe enough to invert X^T X (alpha handles this)
Feature scales matter: StandardScaler applied before fitting

hyperparameters.alpha_selected: tuned via 3-fold TimeSeriesSplit CV on training logs

training.nan_strategy: drop rows with any NaN in features
